entities.definition: Abstract supertype of every Technology Architecture entity; retained for compatibility with earlier mapping documents
entities.reasoning: SDEM's abstract supertype of every A4 entity, never instantiated. No standard defines it; it exists so the DEPLOYED_ON relationship type can target 'any infrastructure' without listing each kind.
entities.confidence_basis: SDEM definition with no standard concept; validated against sealed answers

identifier.reasoning: never instantiated in an architecture dataset, so it has no identifier

entities.definition: An application as deployed into a specific environment

reference.locator: extension of A4.Artifact assigned to A4.Node

entities.reasoning: SDEM extension: in ArchiMate a deployment is an Artifact assigned to a Node (ch. 10). SDEM makes the deployment a first-class record so it can carry component, environment and platform and be traced.
entities.confidence_basis: built on a standard concept as SDEM chose to model it

identifier.reasoning: one deployment per component, environment and platform

entities.definition: A governed runtime boundary such as production or test
entities.reasoning: SDEM extension: ArchiMate has no environment element; environments are usually modelled as a grouping of Nodes. SDEM names it so production, UAT and similar can be traced and aggregated.
entities.confidence_basis: built on a standard concept as SDEM chose to model it

identifier.reasoning: no standard key; SDEM recommends a unique name within the architecture dataset so duplicates can be detected
